scope: Six old-board implementation banks. No solver inference or pooling; every weight, endpoint, stream and count freezes before pilot.
noise_draw_rule: Independent eta=.05 replacement. Calibration draws uniform(1000,2),then int8 offsets1..8. One M1000 calibration result is reused by both learned selectors. Training draws81 uniforms then81 offsets per row, after every current mask finalizes.
budget: Six old training banks and six independent calibration draws only; no solver inference and no extension.
nesting: Source boards, ties, calibration and potential training noise are paired across selectors and known/learned bounds. Masks can differ; no nested-mask claim.

selector: Exposure uses unchanged(8/9)^pastjoint. Bounded weights use numpy.power(8/9,m)*exp(clip((m*logB+c*(logA-logB))/2,0,log16)), zero for exclusions/diagonal. FP64 order: logLR expression,divide2,clip,exp,multiply exposure base. Same greedy25/tie permutation; past queried data only. Factor[1,16] is fixed, without a sweep.
